mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, title, content, target_type, target_id, payload_json, read_at, dedupe_key, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{payloadJson}, NULL, #{dedupeKey}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, type, title, content, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, payload_json AS payloadJson, read_at AS readAt, dedupe_key AS dedupeKey, created_at AS createdAt FROM notification WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, type, title, content, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, payload_json AS payloadJson, read_at AS readAt, dedupe_key AS dedupeKey, created_at AS createdAt FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
